title: add RAG agent quickstarts + tool-calling examples and docs site updates
author: Priya Shah
description: This PR adds a focused set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts, several tool-calling examples, and the corresponding docs site updates to make it straightforward for engineers to prototype RAG-based agents using Redwood. Motivation: customers frequently ask for end-to-end examples that combine embeddings, vector stores, and tool calling (retrievers, search connectors, and simple external tool stubs). The quickstarts are small, opinionated, and tested against the latest SDKs so developers can iterate quickly. Changes include: new RAG templates (python/ts), an agent playground example that demonstrates tool-calling and structured output, updated docs pages and navigation entries, and a new example test harness that validates outputs against golden prompts. Checklist: - [x] Add python quickstart with inline setup and example prompts - [x] Add typescript quickstart with tool-calling and streaming output - [x] Add docs site pages and navigation entries - [x] Add small unit/integration tests for examples - [x] Ensure CI/examples build passes. How to review: focus on clarity of quickstarts, reproducibility of examples, and docs copy. Test locally: run the example harness (./examples/rag/README.md) and verify the golden prompt asserts. This is a merge-ready docs+examples change; no production runtime changes. Related items: ENG-5216 (RAG quickstarts epic).
